1.en: which you shall recite to them

2.ja: קל להם אד'א אבתעת עבדא עבראניה
2.en: Say to them: If you purchase a Hebrew slave
he shall serve you six years
and in the seventh, he shall go out free, without payment

3.en: If he entered single, he shall go out single

3.ja: ואן כאן ד'ו זוגה. כ'רגת זוגתה מעה
3.en: and if he was possessed of a wife, his wife shall go out with him
3.he: אִם-בַּעַל אִשָּׁה הוּא וְיָצְאָה אִשְׁתּוֹ עִמּוֹ

4.en: And if his master gave him a woman in marriage
and she bore him sons or daughters
the woman and her children shall belong to his master
and he shall go out single

5.en: I have come to love my master
and my wife and my children
I will not go out free

6.en: then his master shall bring him before the judge

6.ja: ויקדמה אלי' אלמצראע. ואלי' כ'די אלבאב
6.en: and shall bring him to the door-leaf and to the doorposts
and shall mark his ear with a branding iron
and he shall serve him forever

7.en: And if a man sells his daughter as a maidservant
she shall not go out as the going-out of the male slaves

8.en: If she is displeasing to her master
who had intended to marry her, he shall redeem her

8.ja: ולבעץ' אלקום ג'ריב. לא יתסלט אן יביעהא
8.en: he has no power to sell her to some other person who is a stranger to her
since he has been faithless to her

9.en: And if he betroths her to his son
he shall deal with her according to the custom due to daughters

10.en: her food, her clothing, and her appointed times

11.ja: ואן לם יצנע בהא ואחדה מן הד'א אלת'לאת'
11.en: And if he does not do for her one of these three things
then she shall go out without payment, without price

12.en: And whoever strikes a person and kills him

13.en: But if he did not intend it
rather God brought it about in His decree

13.ja: אני אצייר לך מוצ'עא. יהרב אליה
13.en: I shall designate for you a place to which he may flee
13.he: וְשַׂמְתִּי לְךָ מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה

14.ja: ואן אתקח אנסאן. עלי' צאחבה פקתלה בכ'בת'
14.en: And if a man acts presumptuously against his fellow and kills him by stealth

14.ja: חתי מן ענד מד'בחי כ'דה ואקתלה
14.en: even from beside My altar take him and put him to death

15.ja: ומן צ'רב אביה ואמה פליקתל קתלא
15.en: And whoever strikes his father or his mother shall be put to death

16.ja: ומן סרק נפסא מן בני אסראיל פבאעה
16.en: And whoever kidnaps a person from the sons of Israel and sells him
or is found with him in his possession, shall be put to death

17.ja: ומן שתם אביה ואמה פליקתל קתלא
17.en: And whoever curses his father or his mother shall be put to death

18.ja: וצ'רב אחדהמא צאחבה. בחגר או בשאדך'
18.en: and one of them strikes his fellow with a stone or with a wounding object

18.ja: ולא ימות בל וקע עלי' אלפראש
18.en: and he does not die but takes to his bed

19.ja: פאן הו קאם. ומשא פי אלסוק עלי' וכאיה לנפסה
19.en: if he rises and walks about in the market on his own supports
then the one who struck him is acquitted
except for his loss of work, which he shall give him
and for medical treatment he shall treat him

20.ja: ואן צ'רב אנסאן עבדה. או אמתה בקצ'יב
20.en: And if a person strikes his slave or his maidservant with a rod
20.he: וְכִי-יַכֶּה אִישׁ אֶת-עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ אֶת-אֲמָתוֹ בַּשֵּׁבֶט

20.en: and he dies under his hand
he shall be penalized for him

21.en: But if he survives a day or two days
he shall not be penalized for him, for he is his property

22.en: and they strike a pregnant woman
the one who struck her shall be fined as her husband requires of him
22.he: עָנוֹשׁ יֵעָנֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר יָשִׁית עָלָיו בַּעַל הָאִשָּׁה

22.en: and he shall give it by fair assessment

23.en: But if there is a fatality
then impose a life in place of a life

24.en: and the blood-price of an eye in place of an eye
and a tooth in place of a tooth
and a hand in place of a hand
and a foot in place of a foot

25.en: and a burn in place of a burn
and a gash in place of a gash
and a wound in place of a wound

26.ja: ואן צ'רב אנסאן עין עבדה. או עין אמתה
26.en: And if a person strikes the eye of his slave or the eye of his maidservant
26.he: וְכִי-יַכֶּה אִישׁ אֶת-עֵין עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ-אֶת-עֵין אֲמָתוֹ

26.en: he shall set him free as a free person in place of his eye

27.ja: ואן טרח סן עבדה. או סן אמתה
27.en: And if he knocks out the tooth of his slave or the tooth of his maidservant
he shall set him free as a free person in place of his tooth

28.ja: ואן נטח תור. רגל או אמראה וקתלה
28.en: And if an ox gores a man or a woman and kills him
28.he: וְכִי-יִגַּח שׁוֹר אֶת-אִישׁ אוֹ אֶת-אִשָּׁה וָמֵת

28.en: and its flesh shall not be eaten
but the owner of the ox is clear

29.ja: ואן כאן ת'ור נטאח מן אמס ומא קבלה
29.en: But if the ox was a habitual gorer from yesterday and the day before
29.he: וְאִם שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם

29.en: and its owner was warned but did not guard it
and it kills a man or a woman
and its owner shall also be put to death

30.en: If a blood-price is imposed upon him
he shall give the redemption of his life
all that is imposed upon him

31.en: And if it gores a son or a daughter
the same ordinance shall be done to it

32.en: If the ox gores a slave or a maidservant
he shall give their master thirty shekels of silver
and the ox shall be stoned

33.en: And if a person uncovers a pit
or digs a pit and does not cover it
and an ox or a donkey falls into it

34.ja: פליג'רם צאחב אלביר ת'מנה. וירדה אלי' רבה
34.en: the owner of the pit shall pay its price and restore it to its owner
34.he: בַּעַל הַבּוֹר יְשַׁלֵּם כֶּסֶף יָשִׁיב לִבְעָלָיו

34.en: and the dead animal shall be his

35.ja: ואן צדם ת'ור אנסאן. ת'ור צאחבה ומאת
35.en: And if one man's ox strikes his fellow's ox and it dies
they shall sell the living ox and divide its price
and the dead one they shall also divide

36.ja: פאן ערף. אנה ת'ור נטאח מן אמס ומא קבלה
36.en: But if it was known that it was a habitual gorer from yesterday and the day before
36.he: אוֹ נוֹדַע כִּי שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם

36.en: and its owner did not guard it
he shall deliver an ox in place of his ox
and the dead one shall be his

37.ja: ואן סרק אנסאן ת'ור או שאה
37.en: And if a person steals an ox or a sheep
and slaughters it or sells it
he shall deliver five in place of the ox
and four in place of the sheep
